verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents API calls an agent can use to start a purchase. Agent Checkouts starts a checkout run from a product URL and spending cap, the user can steer the run, and the headless checkout is a set of REST APIs. Neither is shown to be an editable cart or order-draft object, and no update call is documented. Missing for 10: a documented create-cart/order-draft endpoint, a documented update/modify operation on the draft (items, quantities, shipping), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call

citations.quote: Start a checkout run, handle its messages and secure inputs, and let the user steer the agent
a product URL and a spending cap, and Crossmint completes the checkout on your user's behalf
Crossmint's headless checkout API is a set of REST APIs that allow you to integrate credit card and cross-chain crypto payments inside your app with full control of the user experience.
